name: Micron Technology
business_model: Designs and manufactures DRAM (incl. HBM) and NAND and sells them to OEMs, hyperscalers and module/channel customers under periodically renegotiated agreements; from 2026 also multi-year take-or-pay Strategic Customer Agreements.

name: SK hynix
business_model: DRAM (incl. HBM) and NAND manufacturer; formerly Hyundai Electronics/Hynix Semiconductor.

name: Samsung Electronics
business_model: Conglomerate whose Device Solutions division makes memory (DRAM, HBM, NAND), System LSI chips and runs a foundry business.

name: Kioxia
business_model: NAND flash manufacturer with plants at Yokkaichi and Kitakami, Japan.

name: CXMT
business_model: Chinese DRAM maker (DDR and LPDDR) founded by a Hefei government investment vehicle; listed on Shanghai STAR Market in July 2026.

name: YMTC
business_model: Chinese 3D NAND flash maker backed by state-linked investors; on the US Entity List since December 2022.

name: Qimonda
business_model: DRAM maker carved out of Infineon in 2006; insolvent January 2009; patents later sold to Infineon.

name: Elpida Memory
business_model: Japanese DRAM maker; received public capital in 2009, filed for reorganisation in February 2012 and was acquired by Micron.
